requirement:
CSS reports only `Comment` attachments. These include `/* … */` blocks and
`//` line comments recognized by the bundled CSS grammar.
rationale:
The subject `requirements.sdk.sources.css.attachments` has two obligations. CSS must report only `Comment` attachments. Those comments include `/* … */` blocks and `//` line comments that the bundled grammar recognizes.

`crates/trust-but-verify/tests/outline_content.rs#fn[bundled_languages_classify_only_their_attachment_syntax]` carries a `{test}` reference to this requirement. Its `test.css` case uses the source `/* block */\na { color: red; }\n// line\n`. It collects every attachment from every outline item, sorts them by span start, and checks the full list of `(kind, trimmed text)` pairs with `assert_eq!`. The expected list is exactly `[(Comment, "/* block */"), (Comment, "// line")]`.

- **Block comments:** the `/* block */` entry checks that `/* … */` comments are reported as `Comment`.
- **Line comments:** the `// line` entry checks that `//` comments are reported as `Comment`.
- **Only `Comment`:** the assertion compares the whole attachment list. An extra attachment, or one of kind `Annotation`, would make the test fail.

The requirement names no other CSS scenarios, such as `//` inside a string or `url(...)`, so I treated none as required. I did not need to read the implementation.
